answer: The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in ember, expire in nebula, and willow lists each expiry. Someone running 91 aliases therefore needs 179 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3843 identities would post 3217 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
